title: BSG: Big Space Guns
description:
BSG: Big Space Guns is a coop bullet hell roguelike where you step on giant buttons to interact with cannons while you dodge bullets. 

This game is for anyone who either wants to have fun playing and goofing around with their friends or for players who are looking for a challenge.

The game features a tiny hitbox that's a few pixels large at the center of the character. You also have a few powers to pick from to help you dodge bullets or just move faster.

The game has two main modes. In the first one, you start with one cannon and progressively get more cannons throughout the run. The second mode gets you started straight away with three cannons, and you choose an upgrade for each cannon throughout the run.

Facts:

• Tiny hitbox

• Two main game modes and more fun or challenging modes

• 8 Temporary power ups

• Many cannons

• Many bosses
